title: SharePoint Online Architecture & Site Provisioning Governance
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Microsoft 365 SharePoint administration).

SharePoint Online Management Shell / PnP PowerShell and the M365 admin center authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; plan-/version-dependent behavior (licensing/plan tiers, Premium features, Commercial vs Government cloud URLs like *.office365.us) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant', never invented. Third-party devices/apps/tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names. Compliance/legal determinations (records schedules, legal holds, info-barrier policy) deferred to compliance/legal.
hook: Design a SharePoint Online architecture that stays organized as it grows
problem: Without an architecture, SharePoint Online becomes thousands of ungoverned sites nobody can navigate. This solution designs the SPO information architecture and provisioning governance: hub-and-site structure, site types and templates, a provisioning process (request → approve → provision) with naming, metadata/taxonomy (managed metadata), and lifecycle — so sites are consistent, findable, and governed from creation.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the IA + provisioning model: hubs/sites, site types + templates, provisioning workflow, naming, taxonomy, and lifecycle.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (SPO admin, group source of truth, taxonomy owners, provisioning tooling, stakeholders).

Implementation Guide — design the hub/site structure, define site templates, build the provisioning process (PnP templates + approval) with naming + metadata, and set lifecycle — pilot-first, each hub/site/template named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic SharePoint Online Management Shell / PnP PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (sites provisioned to standard, hubs associated, taxonomy applied) plus Best Practices for a governed, navigable SPO estate.
short: Design the SharePoint Online architecture & provisioning governance — hub/site structure, site templates, a request→approve→provision process with naming, taxonomy, and lifecycle — so sites are consistent and governed. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
